title: GoalProfile
description: Intent-specific overlay that governs conflict resolution when other profiles disagree, and tunes convergence to the goal of this book. Conflict precedence: Constraint > Sensitivity > Goal > Genre > Audience > Author > Universal. See core-ontology-v3.md §13 and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Phase 4 T4.5.

intent.description: Primary production intent. Drives weight overrides and quality gate priorities.

word_count_target.description: Target word count for the finished manuscript.

timeline.description: Production timeline targets. Stub — expand during Phase 13 Dashboard implementation.

genre.description: Primary genre for this project (links to genre_profile.genre_id).

series_position.description: Position within series (1 = standalone or book 1).

critic_weight_modifiers.description: Multiplicative weight overrides for named critic scores in Convergence Controller. e.g. {voice_critic: 1.5} elevates voice weight. Stub — expand during Phase 7.

reader_weight_modifiers.description: Multiplicative weight overrides for named reader persona scores.

sacred_thresholds.description: Quality gate IDs that cannot be relaxed even on FORCE-RESOLVE. Sensitivity thresholds are always sacred regardless of this list.

flexible_thresholds.description: Gate ID → override value for thresholds that this goal can relax (within Sensitivity limits). Stub — expand during Phase 7.

force_resolve_direction.description: How to choose the winning candidate on FORCE-RESOLVE.

success_criteria.description: Measurable success targets for this book. Stub — expand per intent during Phase 5 T5.6.
